menu.title: {bot} help
menu.adminSteps:
1. **/configwizard** sets the mod role and log channel.
2. **/commands dashboard** turns categories on or off.
3. Pick a category in the menu below to see its commands.
menu.memberSteps:
Pick a category in the menu below to see its commands.
Need staff? DM the bot: your message goes to the team privately (modmail).
menu.accessAdmin: • Commands marked 🔒 need the **Administrator** permission; the rest are for everyone.
menu.accessMember: • This list shows the commands you can use.
menu.accessSetup: • **/setup** shows what is set up in this server, with a link to the dashboard.
menu.accessAppeals: • **/setappeal** posts the appeal panels; **/appeals** lists, shows and decides appeals.
menu.goodToKnowText:
• Most features have a dashboard command for their settings
• Settings are saved per server

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.description:
Tell us in the support server what happened. It helps if you include:
- what you did (the command and its options)
- what you expected and what happened instead
- a screenshot, if you have one

dashboard.title: Command access
dashboard.description: Commands for **{server}**. Subcommands (like `birthday list`) are counted on their own.
dashboard.summaryCategories: {full} categories fully on · {partial} partly on · {off} off
dashboard.howToOverview:
• Pick a category below to turn its commands on or off
• `/commands disable` turns off a category or one command
• `/commands enable` turns it back on
dashboard.howToCategory:
• Pick a command in the menu to turn it on or off
• **Disable all** turns off the whole category
• **Clear overrides** turns back on the ones you switched off one by one
dashboard.categoryFooter: Commands marked "always" can't be turned off
dashboard.pickCommand: Turn a command on or off
dashboard.otherServer: This dashboard belongs to another server.

config.dmHelp:
1. Right-click this server's name (mobile: tap the server name at the top).
2. Open **Privacy Settings**.
3. Turn on **Allow direct messages from server members**.
4. Click **Start setup** again.
config.started: Check your DMs, the first question is there. Press **Skip** under a question to keep its current value.
config.dmBlocked:
I couldn't send you a DM. Enable DMs from this server, then try again.

prompt.prefixQuestion:
What command prefix should this server use?
Current: `{prefix}`
Type the new prefix, or press **Skip** to keep it.
prompt.prefixRule: Prefix must be 1-10 characters with no spaces.
prompt.logQuestion:
Which channel should receive bot logs?
Send a channel mention or channel ID, or `none` to clear it. Press **Skip** to keep the current one.
prompt.logInvalid: Provide a valid channel mention or ID from this server.
prompt.modQuestion:
What role should moderators have?
Send a role mention or role ID, or `none` to clear it. Press **Skip** to keep the current one.
prompt.modInvalid: Provide a valid role mention or ID from this server.

config.intro:

• **Stop setup** stops the setup
